<Popover>

    <Button tone="outline" size="sm">
      With arrow

  <PopoverContent variant="arrow" className="w-56">
    <PopoverHeader>
      <PopoverTitle>Arrow</PopoverTitle>

      </PopoverDescription>
    </PopoverHeader>
  </PopoverContent>
</Popover>
